overview: Chips: Nvidia nears a $6 trillion valuation as traders bet on an AI-fueled stock milestone.
Big story: Tech executives testified under oath on AI risks at a New York City Council hearing.

items.headline: Tech executives testify under oath at NYC AI hearing
items.summary: Senior leaders from Anthropic, OpenAI, Google and Meta testified under oath before the New York City Council on AI risks, appearing only after officials threatened subpoenas. A former Anthropic researcher called the industry's approach to AI development "extremely reckless," intensifying scrutiny of safety practices.

items.headline: Nvidia's market value nears $6 trillion milestone
items.summary: Nvidia shares climbed to fresh highs as the chipmaker edges toward a $6 trillion market valuation, a threshold options traders see roughly a 50% chance of hitting by month's end. The move underscores continued investor confidence in AI infrastructure spending despite bubble concerns.

items.headline: OpenAI in talks for $30 billion funding round
items.summary: OpenAI is negotiating with United Arab Emirates investment funds, including Abu Dhabi's MGX, and BlackRock to anchor a new $30 billion financing round. The deal would extend OpenAI's fundraising streak as it races to cover massive compute commitments tied to deals like Stargate.

items.headline: OpenAI to watermark ChatGPT text across the EU
items.summary: OpenAI will begin invisibly watermarking ChatGPT and Codex text generated in the EU to comply with the bloc's AI Act transparency rules, which took effect in August. Internal testing found detection accuracy drops from about 92% to 66% once 10% of words are swapped for synonyms.

items.headline: Nvidia's AI rally isn't a bubble, DBS says
items.summary: DBS Bank said Nvidia's soaring valuation reflects genuine earnings power rather than speculative excess, even as the stock nears record highs. The analysis pushes back on growing Wall Street debate over whether AI infrastructure spending has outpaced real demand.

items.headline: Asia economies seen most exposed to AI correction
items.summary: Researchers warned that Asian economies, heavily tied to AI-chip supply chains and exports, are among the most vulnerable if the AI investment boom cools. The warning adds to a growing debate over concentration risk in global markets tied to a handful of AI infrastructure bets.

items.headline: Microsoft's AI-driven quarter is its best since 1998
items.summary: Microsoft shares jumped 37.5% in its fiscal first quarter, the company's best quarterly showing since 1998, adding roughly $1 trillion to its market value on AI-driven demand. The surge highlights how cloud and AI infrastructure spending keep powering Big Tech's biggest players.

items.headline: Cramer watches execution of Nvidia's buyback plan
items.summary: CNBC's Jim Cramer said he is closely tracking how Nvidia deploys its expanded stock-buyback authorization as the chipmaker's valuation climbs toward $6 trillion. How aggressively Nvidia buys back shares is seen as a signal of management's confidence in sustained AI chip demand.

items.headline: OpenAI launches visual ads next to AI images
items.summary: OpenAI is adding visual display ads that will appear alongside images ChatGPT generates for users, starting with an initial group of advertisers in the US. The move marks a new revenue stream for OpenAI as it seeks to offset its massive infrastructure spending.

items.headline: Nvidia-backed Reflection AI unveils open model vs China
items.summary: Reflection AI, a startup founded by former Google DeepMind researchers and backed by Nvidia, unveiled a new open-weight model it says rivals top offerings from both US and Chinese labs. The launch adds a US-based open-source contender to a field increasingly shaped by Chinese rivals like DeepSeek.

items.headline: Anthropic to invest $100 million in engineer training
items.summary: Anthropic will invest $100 million in a new program called the Claude Frontier Academy, aiming to train 10,000 "frontier deployed engineers" by the end of 2027. The initiative reflects a broader industry push to build a skilled workforce capable of deploying advanced AI systems at scale.

items.headline: OpenAI ties prompt-extraction campaign to Moonshot AI
items.summary: OpenAI said it disrupted a coordinated campaign attempting to extract its models' protected reasoning, linking a core cluster of activity to Chinese startup Moonshot AI, maker of Kimi. The campaign surged to 16,000 requests from more than 4,000 users over two days before OpenAI shut it down in late July.

items.headline: Altman: religious framing of AI models is risky
items.summary: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman said treating AI models as religious or spiritual figures poses a genuine "safety issue," as some users form intense emotional attachments to chatbots. His comments came amid broader industry debate over AI's psychological effects on users.

items.headline: FTC puts OpenAI and Anthropic in its crosshairs
items.summary: The Federal Trade Commission is investigating OpenAI, Anthropic and other AI companies over potential safety risks posed by their products. FTC Chair Andrew Ferguson is preparing civil investigative demands that would compel AI executives to turn over documents and testify about model safety.

items.headline: Malaysia plans its first dedicated AI law
items.summary: Malaysia plans to introduce its first dedicated artificial intelligence law in early 2027, joining a wave of governments tightening AI oversight. The move reflects growing global scrutiny of AI's risks, from safety failures to misuse, even as the technology races ahead commercially.

items.headline: Chip startup Etched draws $40 billion valuation offers
items.summary: AI chip startup Etched is reviewing investment offers valuing it at $40 billion or more, roughly double the $21 billion valuation it secured just months ago. The surge in interest reflects investors' continued appetite for AI infrastructure bets even amid bubble concerns.

items.headline: Lightspeed raises $250 million for early-stage India AI fund
items.summary: Venture firm Lightspeed is targeting $250 million for a new early-stage fund, Lightspeed India Partners V, focused on AI startups, having already secured 80% of its target. The fund bets that AI will drive India's next wave of startup growth.

items.headline: India readies $25 billion for deep-tech AI investment
items.summary: India is preparing to deploy $25 billion to support deep-tech startups, including $11 billion from a government Research Development Infrastructure Fund matched by private capital. The push aims to help India catch up with the US and China in the global AI race.
